title: Angry Dental Patient Kills Two Dentists
description:
Tyler, Texas police respond after a disgruntled patient, Steven Alexander Smith, allegedly shot and killed Dr. Jack Burroughs Jr. and Dr. Blake Sinclair at Affordable Dentures. Smith was tracked to his home, where a standoff ended before he was taken into custody. Watch on Law&Crime BodyCam.
